title: Change Fees Waived Under a Wanderlane Traveller Club Tier
content:
Some tiers of the Wanderlane Traveller Club waive a number of change fees in a membership year. Where such a tier stands on a traveller's active club card, what that traveller pays of a figure reached on a package sold under Wanderlane's Vacation Package Products turns on how many of those waived change fees the club ledger shows used in the last twelve months.

## The share payable

**Where an active club card stands in the traveller's name whose tier waives change fees in a membership year and the club ledger shows no waived change fee used in the last twelve months** — 0 such benefit entries in that window — nothing of the figure so reached is payable.

**Where such a card stands in the traveller's name and the club ledger shows at least one waived change fee used in the last twelve months but fewer than the tier grants in a membership year** — at least 1, and short of the tier's own allowance — one half of the figure so reached is payable, that is 50 per cent of it.

**Where no active club card stands in the traveller's name, or the tier on it waives no change fee in a membership year, or the waived change fees the club ledger shows used in the last twelve months have reached the tier's allowance**, nothing in this note reduces the figure so reached.

## Where the records are read

The card and its tier are read from the traveller's Wanderlane Traveller Club membership, and it must be an active card. The number of change fees that tier waives in a membership year is the allowance recorded against that tier of the club. The waived change fees used are the benefit entries on the club's own points ledger recorded as a waived change fee, counted over the last twelve months.

## Worked on hypothetical particulars

A traveller whose active club card carries a tier waiving 2 change fees in a membership year, with no waived change fee on the club ledger in the last twelve months, pays nothing of a figure of 390.00 USD.

The same traveller, the club ledger showing 1 waived change fee used in the last twelve months, is short of the 2 the tier grants, so one half of the figure is payable: 195.00 USD.

The same traveller again, the club ledger showing 2 waived change fees used in the last twelve months, has reached the allowance, and the figure of 390.00 USD stands unreduced by this note.
